attchmntText: Landmark Cars Limited has submitted to exchange the extract of Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, published in Financial Express in English edition on November 13, 2026 and in Gujarati edition on November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Landmark Cars Limited has published the extract of its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The publication appeared in the Financial Express English edition on November 13, 2026, and the Gujarati edition on November 14, 2026. The document also contains unrelated financial data for Liberty Shoes Limited and Aegis Logistics Limited. Liberty Shoes reported total income from operations of 19,046.97 lakh for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with a net profit after tax of 142.00 lakh. Aegis Logistics reported total income from operations of 21,674.49 lakh for the half year ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Landmark Cars Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Audio Recording of Analyst/Investor Earnings Conference Call held on November 13, 2026 at 09:00 AM (IST) to discuss the Unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Disclosure is enclosed herewith.
Landmark Cars Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Proposed investments in Wholly Owned Subsidiaries'.
Landmark Cars Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation

Landmark Cars Limited has informed the exchange regarding the outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026, and submitted the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The detailed outcome is enclosed herewith.

Landmark Cars Limited has informed the exchange about the schedule of earning conference call with analysts/investors on Friday, November 13, 2026, at 09:00 AM (IST) to discuss the Unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
Landmark Cars Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
Landmark Cars Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 26, 2026, titled "Landmark Cars signs letters of intent with JSW Motors for its New Passenger Cars Brand."
